Combine Delphi data objects

Source: R/delphi_data.R
delphi_bind.Rd

Combines delphi_data objects that hold different rounds, different indicators or both, for example one table per round of the same study.

Usage

delphi_bind(...)

Arguments

...

delphi_data objects, or a single list of them.

Value

A delphi_data object.

Details

Experts are matched by their identifier, so the same expert must have the same identifier in every table. If any of the objects is not linked (linked = FALSE in delphi_data()), the combined object is not linked either. An indicator that appears in several objects must have the same scale in all of them. Items are kept in order of first appearance.

Examples

r1 <- data.frame(expert = c("A", "B", "C"), E1 = c(4, 8, 6), E2 = c(2, 9, 5))
r2 <- data.frame(expert = c("A", "B", "C"), E1 = c(6, 7, 6), E2 = c(4, 7, 5))
x <- delphi_bind(
  delphi_data(r1, expert_col = "expert", round = 1),
  delphi_data(r2, expert_col = "expert", round = 2)
)
delphi_panel(x)
#>   round respondents retained dropped joined retention
#> 1     1           3       NA      NA     NA         1
#> 2     2           3        3       0      0         1
